capabilities: Drag ruler margin markers to change text width
Set exact widths via commands, presets or typed values (px, cm, in, ch)
Save per-note widths in a frontmatter property
Configure default width, units and presets in settings
extras: Not yet in the Community plugins directory; install via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. The README notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's Readable line length is all or nothing: a narrow 700 px column, or the whole pane.
problem: Obsidian's Readable line length setting is all-or-nothing, offering only a narrow default width or the full pane, with no visual or in-between control.

relations.evidence: Install and enable BRAT from Settings → Community plugins → Browse.

summary: Google Docs-style ruler above notes for dragging margin markers to set text line width, per note or for all notes, in any unit.
